subject: gpu-builder-smoke
scope: saved evidence and actual file hashes only; no codec/native/CUDA execution, download or new measurement

quality.scope: 4 exact+8 warmup+28 measurement results; separate fresh decoder verification also passed

adapter_counter_scope: calling-thread checked adapter counters; per-result before/after live bytes zero; not full CUDA-runtime allocation or sampled VRAM

actual_profile.cuda_context_scope: library/device initialization outside object clocks; new interpreter per experiment session
actual_profile.gpu_allocation_scope: source-accounted simultaneous adapter-owned requested allocation capacity; excludes CUDA context/runtime/cache, allocator granularity and pre-existing prepared owners; not a sampled VRAM peak
actual_profile.gpu_event_scope: completed CUDA stream work: scratch/output zeroing, host-path H2D when present, FIXED kernel and encoded rate/size D2H; not kernel-only

host_memory_limit.scope: host process virtual address space, including driver mappings; not RSS

runtime.gpu_scope: actual mapped CUDA runtime/driver/NVIDIA libraries plus build runtime dependencies and explicit preload

actual_profile.thread_definition: adapter algorithm host parallelism; excludes driver/runtime helper threads
actual_profile.thread_evidence: adapter has no algorithm host thread pool; driver/runtime process Threads are observed separately

vram_limit.reason: no enforceable per-process VRAM budget API in this adapter; allocation accounting is separate

time_window.test_reference_scope: saved installed validation output-file mtime, not a per-trial clock

limitations: One session with seven rounds on two synthetic objects, two boundaries; smoke correctness under declared policies, not a broad performance result.
Decoder recovery has PID/source/native/profile but no persisted native diagnostics/process snapshot; qualification/main-worker counter evidence cannot fill this gap.
Mapped Anaconda libstdc++/libgcc differ from build-time system library identities; both are preserved separately.
VRAM budget is not enforced; adapter allocation counts are not sampled VRAM peak.
Margin90 is an explicit previously observed sensitivity policy, not universal bounded quality guarantee.
